assignments.rationale: The strongest cues are strict fidelity to supplied claims, ordinary transitions, direct syntax, a concise non-expansive conclusion, and proportional mention of a single limitation. Together these describe neutral editing that improves clarity without adding analysis or recommendations.

Numbered taxonomies and paired alternatives establish explicit analytical categories, while conditional clauses and causal connectives trace conditions through mechanisms, consequences, and responses. That causal-chain structure is the clearest fit for system-safety and boundary analysis.

The card emphasizes opposing practical concerns, direct statements of the speaker's practice and uncertainty, pointwise replies, informal analogies, and partial agreement before narrowing the dispute. These cues fit pragmatic software-engineering judgment and technical tradeoff discussion.

Guiding questions expose evaluation dimensions; parallel categories keep comparisons explicit; consequence-first conditions connect findings to implications; and the careful distinction among observations, tendencies, and established results signals calibrated evidential assessment characteristic of Bayesian model criticism.
